profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a passionate software engineer with hands-on experience in full stack development, specializing in React and Python-based back ends. I enjoy architecting robust applications, leading teams, and mentoring engineers—whether that means writing technical curriculum, facilitating peer learning, or coaching new talent. My expertise spans agent-based modeling, backend and frontend problem-solving, and managing high-performing teams for impactful results.
Beyond work, I’m an active musician, which fuels my creative approach to challenges. I believe that creativity and the ability to deconstruct problems are powerful assets in collaborative environments. I am always eager to foster collaboration, share diverse perspectives, and help teams unlock innovative solutions.

positions.title: Data Science Instructor
positions.description:
+ Teach virtual professional development workshops (20+ adults).
+ Prepare and present materials using PowerPoint, Google Collabs, and Google Sheets
+ Collaborate with colleague to plan session, make amendments to materials, and debrief post-lesson.

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description:
+ Read, debug, and make amendments to Python code for “The Technical Higher Education Team” at Google
+ Convert and split Jupyter Notebooks (.ipynb files) into several YAML files for Google Qwiklabs courses using Python
+ Upload and update files and directories onto GitHub using version control with Git

positions.title: Curriculum Designer
positions.description:
+ Write curriculum using Markdown for “The Technical Higher Education Team” at Google
+ Design Python based labs for topics such as linked lists, sets, probability, and sorting algorithms for college students

positions.title: Mathematics Teacher
positions.locationName: North Bergen, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
+ Teach high school level math and computer science to 75 students per year on average. Topics taught include Java, Probability and Statistics, Pre Calculus, Algebra, and Geometry
+ Manage rooms of up to 30 teenagers ensuring safety, communication, and comprehension
Design curriculum independently for a new class of prospective mathematicians
+ Collaborate with colleagues to rewrite curriculum and weekly lesson plans
+ Provide resources and support to students to facilitate development of personal goals
+ Maintain safety and security of halls and classrooms while completing duty responsibilities
+ Facilitate after school programs promoting personal growth and collaboration through self expression, community engagement, and problem solving 
+ Schedule virtual, audio, and in person meetings to discuss parents’ concerns

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
+ Metis is a 12 week intensive program that focuses on enhancing skills used in the data science industry
+ Over the course of 5 projects, used Python and other tools for data acquisition (web scraping/APIs), data management (AWS, MongoDB, SQL, Hadoop), statistical analysis, machine learning (supervised and unsupervised), natural language processing, and data visualization
